scripts.validate:generated: npm run generate && python -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('slides/generated/session-01.md'); assert p.exists() and p.stat().st_size > 0; assert 'undefined' not in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')"
scripts.build: npm run validate:generated && slidev build slides/generated/session-01.md
scripts.export: npm run generate && slidev export slides/generated/session-01.md
scripts.check: npm run validate:json && npm run validate:generated && npm run build && npm run build:showcase
